verdict.rationale: Elastic documents an ES|QL REST endpoint with request-body parameters (filter, time_zone, locale) and machine-readable output formats, which an external agent could call. ES|QL is documented for querying metrics and for ad-hoc log queries. However, the evidence never shows ES|QL or another documented API querying traces, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the probed elastic.co paths. missing for 10: evidence of documented API querying of traces/APM data, external-agent-specific integration guidance (e.g. agent auth or tool interface), a discoverable API spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: ES|QL can return the data in the following human readable and binary formats.
Specify a Query DSL query in the `filter` parameter to filter the set of documents that an ES|QL query runs on.
Query them with ES|QL or Prometheus Query Language (PromQL)
